subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work PB455 + PB561 - LANDED, RE-MEASURED. 'If the FALSE phrase is specified, the FALSE phrase shall be specified in the VALUE clause of the data description entry for condition-name-1.' The screen is a COMPILE-TIME error (COBOL2049) in SetBinder.BindSetCondition, guarded on `!toTrue && cond.FalseValue is null`; measured, `01 WF PIC X VALUE "Y". 88 WF-YES VALUE "Y".` + `SET WF-YES TO FALSE` is `error COBOL2049: ... writes no WHEN SET TO FALSE phrase, so there is no literal-4 to place in the conditional variable (ISO 14.9.39.3 SR7)` at --std 2023. The rule became EXPRESSIBLE only when Condition88.FalseValue existed: before it, the conforming program and the SR7-violating one were byte-identical to the binder, which is what made this row NOT-IMPLEMENTED rather than DIVERGES. The TRUE arm needs no twin screen - 13.18.63.3 SR24 -> SR10 makes a VALUE clause mandatory on a level-88 entry. Landed by e76c275d0 (kb/Work PB555).
